# Date patterns, tried in order. Each returns (month, day).
DATE_RES = [
    (re.compile(r"\b(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})\b"), lambda m: (int(m[2]), int(m[3]))),
    (re.compile(r"\b(\d{1,2})/(\d{1,2})(?:/(\d{2,4}))?\b"), lambda m: (int(m[1]), int(m[2]))),
    (re.compile(r"\b(\d{2})-(\d{2})\b"), lambda m: (int(m[1]), int(m[2]))),
    (re.compile(r"\b(Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec)[a-z]*\.?\s+(\d{1,2})\b", re.I),
     lambda m: (MONTHS[m[1][:3].lower()], int(m[2]))),
]
# Amount: last money-looking token on the line, optional minus/$.
AMT_RE = re.compile(r"(-?)\$?(-?)(\d+\.\d{2})\b")

def parse(line):
    s = line.strip().lstrip("-").strip()
    date_m, rest = None, s
    for rx, fn in DATE_RES:
